record.original_question: Determine the complete weight enumerator of the Melas code, since the chapter explicitly says that this remained open and ties it to Kloosterman sums.

evidence.quote: The problem of the complete determination of the weight enumerator of the Melas code remains open; any result on the number of words of a given weight could apply to the problem of the values of Kloosterman sums.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $q = 2^m$ with $m \geq 3$, and let $\mathbb{F}_q$ be the finite field with $q$ elements. The binary Melas code $M(2,m)$ of length $n = q - 1$ is the cyclic code over $\mathbb{F}_2$ whose dual is generated (as a cyclic code) by the parity-check matrix whose columns are the pairs $(\alpha^i, \alpha^{-i})$, where $\alpha$ is a primitive element of $\mathbb{F}_q$ and $i = 0,1,\dots,n-1$; equivalently, $M(2,m)$ is the binary cyclic code of length $2^m - 1$ whose defining set consists of the cyclotomic cosets of $1$ and $-1$ modulo $2^m - 1$, i.e. its zeros are $\alpha$ and $\alpha^{-1}$. The weight enumerator of $M(2,m)$ is the polynomial
$$W_{M(2,m)}(X,Y) = \sum_{c \in M(2,m)} X^{n - \mathrm{wt}(c)} Y^{\mathrm{wt}(c)} = \sum_{w=0}^{n} A_w\, X^{n-w} Y^w,$$
where $A_w$ is the number of codewords of Hamming weight $w$. For a nontrivial additive character $\psi$ of $\mathbb{F}_q$, the Kloosterman sum is
$$K(a) = \sum_{x \in \mathbb{F}_q^{*}} \psi\!\left(x + a x^{-1}\right), \qquad a \in \mathbb{F}_q^{*}.$$
It is known that the weights in the dual of $M(2,m)$ are expressible in terms of values of $K(a)$, but the precise distribution of these values, and hence the full weight distribution of $M(2,m)$, is not known in closed form.

Problem: Determine explicitly the complete weight enumerator $W_{M(2,m)}(X,Y)$, i.e. give a closed-form expression for the coefficients $A_w$ for every $m \geq 3$ and every $0 \leq w \leq 2^m - 1$.
artifact.status_search_result: Available literature indicates that the weight distribution of the Melas code (equivalently, the distribution of binary Kloosterman sum values) remains an active object of study, with only partial results — such as divisibility characterizations (e.g., Kloosterman sums divisible by 3), moment computations, and asymptotic Sato–Tate type distribution results — but no closed-form complete weight enumerator. No source found indicates a full resolution.

status_evidence.title: On binary Kloosterman sums divisible by 3
status_evidence.snippet: By counting coset leaders for cosets of weight 3 of the Melas code, a new proof can be provided for the characterization of Kloosterman sums divisible by 3.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial divisibility results for Kloosterman sums tied to Melas-code weights are available.

status_evidence.title: Distribution of the weights of the dual of the Melas code
status_evidence.snippet: The dual of the Melas code has weights expressible via Kloosterman sums, distributed asymptotically per Sato–Tate; exact values remain difficult.
status_evidence.claim: Only asymptotic distribution results are known; exact weight enumerator is not.

status_evidence.title: On classical Kloosterman sums
status_evidence.snippet: Determining individual values of Kloosterman sums is very difficult.
status_evidence.claim: The exact determination of Kloosterman sum values, equivalent to determining Melas weights, is unresolved.
